program.name: Phase 4 Staff Surfaces
program.description: The front-of-house surface for the day a class runs: today's schedule, per-participant check-in, and who is currently in the building. CHECKED_IN has been a reservation status since Phase 1 that no code could ever reach, and reservation_participants.checked_in_at has never been set.

technology.checkInGranularity: Per participant via reservation_participants.checked_in_at; the reservation's CHECKED_IN status is a roll-up derived from it, never an independent source of truth
technology.undoCheckIn: Permitted; clears the timestamp and reverts the roll-up when no participant remains checked in
technology.walkUps: Out of scope — creating a reservation from the staff surface means a booking and payment flow
technology.occupancyFreshness: As of page load with an explicit refresh; no polling or streaming
technology.checkOut: No checked_out_at column; occupancy is scoped to in-progress occurrences and self-clears when a class ends
technology.noShow: Permitted, and it releases the seat — NO_SHOW is not seat-consuming under the capacity trigger
technology.statusTransitions: RESERVATION_TRANSITIONS in contracts, mirroring OFFERING_TRANSITIONS and ORDER_TRANSITIONS
technology.auditTrail: recordAuditEntry moves from catalog-admin to packages/database so staff code need not depend on catalog-admin; still written inside each mutation's transaction
technology.timeZone: CAFE_TIME_ZONE moves from apps/web to contracts so a domain package can compute today's boundaries
technology.mutationSurface: Server Actions gated on FRONT_OF_HOUSE via authenticatedAction

successCriteria.description: /staff/today lists today's occurrences with start time, class name, and expected-versus-arrived counts.
"Today" is computed in the cafe's timezone, not the server's, and not as a rolling 24 hours.
Staff can check in an individual participant, setting reservation_participants.checked_in_at.
Checking in the first participant of a reservation moves it CONFIRMED to CHECKED_IN.
Undoing a check-in clears the timestamp, and the reservation returns to CONFIRMED only when no participant remains checked in.
Check-in is idempotent: repeating it preserves the original checked_in_at and writes no second audit row.
Checking in a HELD reservation is refused with a message naming why.
Staff can mark a reservation NO_SHOW, and its seats are released.
An undeclared reservation transition is refused by RESERVATION_TRANSITIONS.
Every staff mutation writes a staff_audit_log row naming the actor, action, and entity.
An audit entry never survives a staff mutation that rolled back.

Phase 3's audit suite still passes after recordAuditEntry moves to packages/database, with its rolled-back-mutation cases unchanged; the only permitted edit is scoping the audit-coverage scan to the offering/occurrence action prefixes WS-01's new reservation actions fall outside.
Every staff action rejects a caller whose role is below FRONT_OF_HOUSE.
/staff/check-in lists an occurrence's participants by name with their check-in state and a control for each.
/staff/occupancy reports checked-in participants of in-progress occurrences, excludes occurrences that have ended, and states its as-of time.
Checking a participant in does not change the occurrence's seat count, since CONFIRMED and CHECKED_IN both consume a seat.
Playwright covers a staff journey: view today, check a participant in, and see occupancy reflect them.

packages.name: staff-ops
packages.description: NEW. Front-of-house write paths (participant check-in, undo, no-show) and staff read paths (today's schedule, occurrence roster, current occupancy), each mutation recording a staff_audit_log entry in its own transaction. Separate from reservation-core, which the customer checkout path imports — a package-boundaries test asserts the customer surface never imports this one.

packages.name: contracts
packages.description: Gains RESERVATION_TRANSITIONS and canTransitionReservation, check-in input schemas, staff AUDIT_ACTIONS members, and CAFE_TIME_ZONE relocated from apps/web.

packages.name: database
packages.description: Receives recordAuditEntry and changedFields from catalog-admin — a single-table insert taking a transaction handle belongs with withTransaction, and both catalog-admin and staff-ops depend on database already.

packages.name: catalog-admin
packages.description: Re-exports the relocated recordAuditEntry so no caller breaks; its Phase 3 audit suite must pass unmodified as proof the move was faithful.

packages.name: auth
packages.description: Unchanged; the FRONT_OF_HOUSE role and authorize predicate already exist and are reused.

packages.name: web
packages.description: The three staff surfaces and their Server Actions: /staff/today, /staff/check-in, /staff/occupancy, replacing PlaceholderPanel.

packages.name: ui
packages.description: Presentational additions for the staff surfaces, reusing StatusBadge and EmptyState from Phase 3.

workstreams.name: Contracts: reservation transitions, check-in schemas, staff audit actions, CAFE_TIME_ZONE
Move recordAuditEntry from catalog-admin to packages/database
staff-ops: check-in, undo, and no-show commands
staff-ops: today's schedule, roster, and occupancy queries
Staff Server Actions with the FRONT_OF_HOUSE boundary

outOfScope: Walk-up bookings, or creating any reservation from the staff surface
Editing or moving a reservation, and changing seat counts
Refunds, and any dependency on refundPayment
Waiver capture at check-in — waiver_record_id stays untouched
Play passes and redemption at check-in
An audit-log viewer — this program writes entries, it does not display them
